title: Astro Portal session event payload: guiding_timeouts
description: A group of guiding settle timeouts (the guiding did not settle within the time allowed) found by Astro Sync in the capture software's log: `count` of them from `firstAt` to `lastAt`. One event per GROUP of close timeouts, never one per timeout: two timeouts more than an hour apart are two groups (the emitter's rule, see session-events.md). The instant of the event is its `recordedAt`, the first timeout of the group. See session-events.md.

description.description: Optional sentence for an application that does not know this type: it shows it as an ordinary report. The applications that know the type compose their own sentence, in the person's language, from the structured fields.
